show.title: Show trail (Public)
show.hint: Makes the trail public, allowing any course member to see it.

hide.title: Hide trail (Private)
hide.hint: Makes the trail private, ensuring only its creator can see the trail.

delete.title: Delete trail
delete.warning: After deleting the trail, all tracks, photos, videos, files will be lost. You will no longer have access to any content from this trail. So please be sure before proceeding.
delete.confirmation: Do you really wish to delete the trail?
delete.description: By deleting a trail you will lose all the content associated with it.
delete.label: Enter the word:
delete.matchError: The word entered does not match the correct word to delete the trail. Please try again.
